caption: The drawing depicts a single iron tool with a linear, elongated body and two curved hooks at each end, one larger than the other. The main body of the tool is a straight, rusty brown metallic rod. Along the rod, there are a series of circular holes, and a smaller supporting projection extends perpendicularly from the left side near the larger hook. The hook on the left curves downward, while the hook on the right curves upward. The background is a plain, light beige color. There is a signature in red ink on the lower right-hand side that reads "Syd R. Roberts."
title: Fireplace Tool
